title: #054. Asymmetric TSP with MTZ Subtour Elimination
subtitle: Eliminate disconnected subtours in the Traveling Salesperson Problem using Miller-Tucker-Zemlin position potentials.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { tour, totalCost }.
judge.m1: tour[{p0}] = {p1} must be an integer city index in [0, {p2}].
judge.m2: City {p0} appears more than once in tour (subtour or incomplete visit detected).
judge.m3: tour must start at city 0 (received tour[0] = {p0}).
judge.m4: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed cycle distance ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid Hamiltonian tour, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
